text:
Barnaby the Brontosaurus was known for his extensive vocabulary, but his social life was a disaster. At dinner parties, he would spend twenty minutes explaining the etymology of "quintessential" to a confused goldfish, only to accidentally eat the appetizer because he was too busy looking up synonyms for "appetizer." His friends didn't mind his verbosity, but they did mind that he always ordered the salad because he couldn't find the right word for "steak" without sounding pretentious.

As for the priority question, the main ingredients in bread are flour, water, yeast, and salt.
